title: Fish in Indian-Style Stew
description: A flavorful and aromatic stew originating from India, made with fish and a blend of spices.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add cumin seeds and let them sizzle for 1 minute.
Add chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add grated ginger and minced garlic, cook for 1 minute.
Add cumin, coriander, and turmeric, cook for 1 minute.
Add fish fillets and cook until browned on both sides, about 3-4 minutes.
Add uncooked rice and stir to combine.
Add coconut milk and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and cook, covered, for 15-20 minutes or until the rice is cooked and the fish is cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped cilantro if desired.
